title: Exact Dimension Threshold, All-d>=8 Rational Witness Family, and Sharp Negativity Bounds for Walled-Brauer NPT Bound Entanglement
abstract: We establish three sharp structural and quantitative advances over Islam Faisal's recent breakthrough proving the existence of NPT bound entangled Werner states (arXiv:2611.34921v1). First, we prove an exact Z[d] isotypic block reduction collapsing Faisal's d^4 x d^4 walled-Brauer semidefinite constraints into 9 fixed-size blocks of dimension at most 6x6 with quadratic integer-polynomial entries (zero square roots) and 6 disjoint 4-term kernel equations; using this reduction we independently verify Faisal's d=8 witness (23/3) via exact zero-float rational LDL^T elimination and construct sharper exact d=8 witnesses reducing A/B to 4717/625 = 7.5472 (+35.84% NPT margin). Second, we prove via U(d) Haar twirling and 19 exact zero-float rational McCormick dual SDP certificates (12 intervals at d=7, minimum dual lower bound 7.017037 > 7) that d_min = 8 is unconditionally the exact sharp minimum dimension of the U(d)-covariant local-CP framework across all d^4 x d^4 Hermitian witnesses Q. Third, we construct a single closed-form degree-2 rational witness proving simultaneously for every integer d >= 8 that rho_d = ((5d+7)I - 6 SWAP)/(d(5d^2+7d-6)) is NPT bound entangled, certified symbolically by 102/102 Bareiss Sylvester leading principal minors having strictly positive coefficients in t = d - 8 >= 0, and we certify sublinear O(sqrt(d)) witnesses up to d=100 (A/B = 24.65, 4.057x relative NPT depth). All algebraic cores are formalized constructively in Lean 4.35.0 (18 theorems, 0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice) alongside 16 SHA-256 zero-float certificates and 56 adversarial tests.
